activity_summary: At eleven Alse came up, sent by Mistress Ansell. You had been so still that the mistress feared you were dead. You sent word that somebody was, and that you were well. You had not walked once.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Answered that he was well, and that he had not walked.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Brought the mistress's fear, and took the answer down.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Called from the stair-foot. She did not come up.

facets.activity: Sent Alse word of being well

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: The mistress says you were so still she feared you were dead.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Somebody is. Tell her I'm well.
